moment.title: Table with the Claude tablecloth
moment.place: An indoor space with concrete walls, green and rusty steel beams, and a worn concrete floor
moment.summary: The recording slowly circles an empty table covered with a dark cloth printed with the word "Claude" and an orange starburst. White folding chairs stand behind it, and a tall "Claude" banner stands beside it. No people appear and no one speaks.

facts.text: A long table was covered with a dark cloth printed with the word "Claude" in white.
facts.cue: A word was printed across the front of the tablecloth.

facts.text: The tablecloth had an orange starburst shape beside the word "Claude" and another on its corner.
facts.cue: There was a bright orange shape like a little sun.

facts.text: A tall white banner reading "Claude" stood next to the table.
facts.cue: Something tall and white stood beside the table.

facts.text: A small name card on the table read "Anthropic".
facts.cue: A little folded card sat on top of the table.

facts.text: Several white folding chairs were lined up behind the table, all empty.
facts.cue: The seats behind the table were waiting for people.

facts.text: The wall behind the table was concrete with green, rusty steel beams.
facts.cue: The walls had old painted metal running across them.

facts.text: A black speaker sat high on a tripod stand behind the chairs.
facts.cue: Something for sound stood up on tall legs.

facts.text: A bright yellow cable cover lay on the floor in front of the table.
facts.cue: There was a strip of bright yellow on the floor.

facts.text: A bare wooden folding table stood to the left of the covered table.
facts.cue: Another table nearby had no cloth on it.

facts.text: A black cloth lay crumpled on the floor beside the tables.
facts.cue: Some fabric was bunched up on the ground.

facts.text: The concrete floor was worn and dotted with old red paint marks.
facts.cue: The floor had specks of color on it.

facts.text: Black equipment cases and cables sat along the wall behind the chairs.
facts.cue: There were boxes and wires tucked behind the seats.
